title: How a great startup video works: humble, chill, and a real cool backstory
summary: A very short post where Pieter Levels shares a startup video he admires (the video itself is not in the text) and says what makes it great: a humble, chill tone and a genuinely interesting backstory. He notes he's unaffiliated with the company.

principles.text: A great startup video feels humble and chill, with a genuinely cool backstory rather than hype.
principles.quote: Humble and chill and a real cool backstory
